_doc: Sửa tay theo từ#loại (mọi bộ) hoặc từ#loại@bộ (một bộ). Trường: ipa, ipaUS, vi, def, ex, col, syn, level. Nghĩa 1 = nghĩa thông dụng nhất (docs/LEXICON.md). Áp bằng: node scripts/build-lexicon.mjs --write

present#adj.def: being in a particular place; existing or happening now

record#n.def: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at later; the best result ever achieved

impression#n.vi: ấn tượng; lượt hiển thị (quảng cáo)

podium#n.def: a small raised platform that a person stands on to speak, conduct music or receive a prize

step#n@ngsl2.def: one of a series of things that you do to achieve something; a movement of putting one foot in front of the other

step#n@ngsl1.def: one of a series of things that you do to achieve something; a movement of putting one foot in front of the other

unreal#adj.ex: Winning the national prize felt completely unreal to her.

administrate#v.ex: Volunteers help to administrate the programme in rural areas.

advertisement#n@education.ex: I saw an advertisement for a cheap phone on TV.

ward#n.vi: phòng bệnh, khoa (bệnh viện); phường (khu hành chính)

work#v@ngsl1.def: to do a job, especially one you are paid for

start#v@ngsl1.def: to begin doing something, or to begin to happen

set#v@ngsl1.def: to put something in a place; to decide on a time, price, rule, etc.

open#v@ngsl1.def: to move something so that it is no longer closed

close#v@ngsl1.def: to move something so that it is no longer open; to shut

hope#v@ngsl1.def: to want something to happen and think that it may happen

fall#v@ngsl2.def: to drop down from a higher place, or to stop standing and go down to the ground

share#v@ngsl2.def: to have or use something together with other people

cover#v@ngsl2.def: to put something over something else to protect or hide it; to deal with a subject

bear#v@ngsl2.def: to accept or deal with something unpleasant

focus#v@ngsl2.def: to give all your attention to one thing

catch#v@ngsl3.def: to take hold of something moving; to get on a bus, train or plane

contribute#v@ngsl5.def: to give money, help or ideas together with other people

elect#v@ngsl6.def: to choose someone for a position by voting

fascinate#v@ngsl8.def: to attract or interest someone very much

withdraw#v@ngsl8.def: to take money out of a bank account; to move back or away

injure#v@ngsl9.def: to hurt a person or animal physically

stimulate#v@ngsl10.def: to make something more active or encourage it to grow

power#n@ngsl2.def: electricity used in homes and machines; also the ability to control people or events

conclude#v@ngsl5.def: to decide that something is true after looking at the facts; to end

golden#adj@ngsl10.def: having the colour of gold; made of gold
golden#adj@ngsl10.vi: vàng óng, màu vàng; bằng vàng

theoretical#adj.vi: thuộc lý thuyết, mang tính lý thuyết

nocturnal#adj.vi: hoạt động về đêm, sống về đêm

assignment#n.vi: bài tập được giao; nhiệm vụ, công việc được giao

brand loyalty#n.vi: lòng trung thành với thương hiệu

panel#n.vi: hội đồng, ban (chuyên gia); tấm (ván, kim loại)

he#pron.def: used to refer to a man, boy or male animal that has already been mentioned

as#conj.def: while; because; used to say that something happens in the same way
as#conj.ex: As I was leaving the house, the phone rang.

by#prep.def: used to show who or what does something; near or beside

all#det.def: the whole number or amount of something; every one

some#det.def: an amount or number of something that is not stated exactly

thing#n.def: an object, idea, action or event that you do not need to name exactly

right#adj.def: correct or true; on or towards the side of the body that most people write with
right#adj.ex: You are right – the station is on the right side of the road.

take#v.ex: Don't forget to take your umbrella with you.

life#n.def: the state of being alive; the way a person lives

too#adv.def: more than is needed or wanted; also

high#adj.def: large in amount, level or value; far above the ground

course#n.def: a series of lessons on a particular subject; the direction in which something moves
course#n.vi: khóa học; hướng đi, tiến trình

state#n.def: the government of a country; a part of a country that has its own government; a condition

form#n.def: a type or kind of something; a document with spaces where you write information

spend#v.def: to use money to pay for things; to use time doing something

love#v.def: to care about and like someone very strongly; to enjoy something very much

side#n.def: one of the two halves or areas of something; an edge or surface of an object

term#n.vi: học kỳ; thuật ngữ; kỳ hạn

together#adv.def: with each other; in the same place or at the same time

hard#adj.def: difficult; firm and solid, not soft

matter#n.ex: There is an important matter we need to discuss.

office#n.def: a room or building where people work, usually at desks

light#n.def: the brightness from the sun, a lamp, etc. that lets you see things

subject#n.def: an area of knowledge studied at school; the thing that is being talked or written about

class#n.def: a group of students who are taught together; a group of people in society

break#v.vi: làm vỡ, làm gãy; làm hỏng

among#prep.def: in the middle of or included in a group of people or things

free#adj.def: costing no money; able to do what you want

history#n.def: the study of past events; the past

along#prep.def: from one end towards the other end of something long, such as a road or river

add#v.def: to put something with something else; to put numbers together to get a total

pass#v.def: to go past or through a place; to succeed in an exam or test

strong#adj.def: physically powerful; not easily broken or damaged

role#n.def: the part or job that someone has in a situation; a character played by an actor

join#v.def: to become a member of a group or organization; to connect things together

difference#n.def: the way in which two or more things are not the same

outside#adv.def: not inside a building; in the open air

charge#n.vi: phí, tiền phải trả; sự sạc (pin)

regard#v.def: to think of someone or something in a particular way

itself#pron.def: used when the thing or animal that does an action is also affected by it; used to emphasize a thing

raise#v.def: to lift or move something to a higher position; to increase an amount or level

stage#n.def: a period or step in a process; a raised area where actors or musicians perform

save#v.def: to keep money so that you can use it later; to rescue someone or something from danger

lie#v.def: to be in a flat position on a surface; to say something that you know is not true

pick#v.def: to choose something from a group; to take flowers or fruit from a plant

inside#prep.ex: There was nothing inside the box.

character#n.def: a person in a book, film or play; the qualities that make a person different from others

enter#v.def: to go into a place; to type or put information into a computer

argue#v.def: to speak angrily to someone because you disagree; to give reasons for or against an idea

statement#n.def: something that you say or write officially

strike#v.ex: Lightning struck the old tree during the storm.

release#v.def: to make a film, album, etc. available to the public; to let someone go free

identify#v.vi: nhận dạng, nhận diện; xác định

fish#n.def: an animal that lives and swims in water; its flesh eaten as food

potential#adj.ex: We discussed the potential risks of the plan.

energy#n.def: power from electricity, fuel, the sun, etc.; the physical and mental strength to do things

speech#n.def: a formal talk given to an audience

oil#n.def: a thick liquid from plants or from under the ground, used for cooking or as fuel
